page_title: VEN 0-1 TOR | Venezia v Torino 30/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Surely that's handball by one of the Torino players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
90+4' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Marcus Pedersen (Torino) was quite harsh and Matteo Marcenaro didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+3' Christian Gytkjaer (Venezia) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the left post.
90+1' Paolo Vanoli has decided to make a change. Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino) replaces Valentino Lazaro.
90+1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Valentino Lazaro (Torino) was quite harsh and Matteo Marcenaro didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
87' The game has come to an end for Antonio Candela. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Antonio Raimondo (Venezia).

86' 0 - 1 Goal! The ball is swung into the box from the resulting corner kick and finds Saul Coco (Torino), who jumps highest and tries his luck with a header from around the penalty spot. His effort is both strong and precise enough to go inside the left post. The score changes to 0:1.
85' It will be a corner kick for Torino.
83' Giorgio Altare (Venezia) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Matteo Marcenaro had an easy-decision to make.
81' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 39:61.
77' Substitution. Adrien Tameze (Torino) on for Che Adams.
77' Substitution. Mergim Vojvoda did his best and is replaced by Ali Dembele (Torino).
77' Eusebio Di Francesco decides to make a substitution. Marin Sverko will be replaced by Giorgio Altare (Venezia).
77' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Christian Gytkjaer (Venezia) replacing Joel Pohjanpalo.
76' Here comes a substitution. Gaetano Oristanio is given a rest as he is replaced by Saad El Haddad (Venezia).
76' Venezia have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
72' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
71' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post.
70' Some great play by Issa Doumbia (Venezia) ends with a shot on the edge of the box low towards the middle of the net, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
68' Alfred Duncan (Venezia) has tested the patience of referee Matteo Marcenaro and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
67' One of the players from Torino times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

65' Ambitious effort from Antonio Candela (Venezia). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
63' Issa Doumbia (Venezia) comes onto the pitch because Hans Nicolussi Caviglia simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
62' Paolo Vanoli has decided to substitute Borna Sosa and he is replaced by Marcus Pedersen (Torino).
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Samuele Ricci departs the field of play to be replaced by Antonio Sanabria (Torino).
62' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
60' The current number of corner kicks is 2:2.
57' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
57' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Valentino Lazaro (Torino) took the corner.

56' Samuele Ricci (Torino) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Jesse Joronen easily deals with the threat. The ball goes out of play. Torino are awarded a corner kick.
54' A decent save by Jesse Joronen. Ivan Ilic (Torino) finds some space near the penalty spot to meet a cross and head it down to the middle of the goal, but the effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
52' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
51' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Matteo Marcenaro blows for a foul.
50' Venezia quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
49' Matteo Marcenaro shows a yellow card to Karol Linetty (Torino) for his blatant foul.
48' Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia) picks up a rebound in space and tries his luck from long range, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+3' Samuele Ricci (Torino) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
45+2' Francesco Zampano (Venezia) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' The linesman raises his flag. Che Adams (Torino) is adjudged offside.
41' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but his low effort is straight at Vanja Milinkovic-Savic.
40' Foul! Valentino Lazaro (Torino) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. There is a free kick near the sideline to Venezia.
39' Matteo Marcenaro interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Jay Idzes (Venezia).
38' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
37' Looks like Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
36' 3:5 – the total goal attempt statistics.
34' The game is interrupted as Che Adams (Torino) is flagged offside.

31' What a chance that is! Duvan Zapata (Torino) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes well wide of the left post!
29' Alfred Duncan (Venezia) brings his opponent down. Matteo Marcenaro has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
28' Torino are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
25' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
24' Samuele Ricci (Torino) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
21' The ratio of the ball possession is 37:63.

18' Jesse Joronen pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Che Adams (Torino) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the bottom left corner, but was stopped by the goalkeeper.

15' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the roof of the net, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save.
15' A quickly taken corner by Venezia.

15' Vanja Milinkovic-Savic pulls off a great save to deny Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the top right corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far! Corner kick. Venezia will have an opportunity.
14' He should have scored! Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
13' Adam Masina (Torino) was too forceful with his tackle and Matteo Marcenaro interrupted the game to signal a free kick. A free kick is awarded to Venezia.
11' Che Adams (Torino) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
10' Karol Linetty (Torino) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle for a foul.
9' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
9' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Che Adams (Torino) heads on.
6' Some neat passing and movement from Torino as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
4' Torino take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

3' Duvan Zapata (Torino) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The ball goes out for a corner. Torino can continue in their attacking effort.
2' Francesco Zampano (Venezia) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Venezia will kick-off.
Matteo Marcenaro is introduced as the referee for today's match.
